700530101.text: #Heya, {NICKNAME}! I was just thinking about you! It's been ages since I last saw you — there's so much we gotta chat about!

700530102.text: My father made a batch of new fireworks yesterday, and I helped him out! The clients were a couple of newlyweds.

700530103.text: I told my father to use all sorts of vibrant colors in the formula. Here's to hoping that explosion of colors will become a part of their wonderful memories together.

700530104.text: And wouldn't you know it, Sayu dropped by yesterday! We even ended up chatting about you.

700530105.text: *sigh* So much has happened while you've been away. There's so much you need to catch up on!

700530106.text: But that's more than enough about me! I didn't even say a proper hello... or ask what you're doing out here.

700530108.text: Sure has! And what a coincidence to run into you here, luck must be on my side. Is there anything special going on here today?

700530110.text: #Ooh, mysterious! Spill the beans, what brings the great {NICKNAME} to a place like this?
